question: What additional duration of austerity was performed at Puṇyaśaila?
premises: The duration was a hundred thousand plus twenty-five.
inference: He performed austerity at Puṇyaśaila for one hundred thousand and twenty-five years.
uncertainties: The exact unit or interpretation of mānataḥ in this compound is unclear.
plain_english: Likewise at Puṇyaśaila, for one hundred thousand and twenty-five years.
